run_create_voc_low_shot_samples: run the script to create low-shot VOC data samples for SVM training with specified k-values
sample_symbol_positive: sample k positive examples for a given class from the VOC targets numpy array
sample_symbol_negative: sample k negative examples for all other classes from the VOC targets numpy array
generate_independent_sample: generate independent low-shot samples by sampling k positives and negatives for each k-value
create_voc_svm_training_data: create VOC low-shot training data files saved as numpy arrays with sampled labels
